designationHistory.name: Lake Malheur Reservation
designationHistory.indexText: Established Aug. 18, 1908, as the Lake Malheur Reservation by Executive Order 929, signed by President Theodore Roosevelt, as a preserve and breeding ground for native birds.

review.note: Confirmed; EO 929 (T.R.). Some FWS documents say "Lake Malheur Bird Reservation"; the CCP and EO wording use "Lake Malheur Reservation".
